newsitem.title: JAPAN: Chrysler recalls some 40,000 Cherokees in Japan.
newsitem.headline: Chrysler recalls some 40,000 Cherokees in Japan.

text.p: Chrysler Japan Sales Ltd, the Japanese unit of Chrysler Corp, said on Tuesday it had told the Transport Ministry it was recalling 40,754 sport-utility vehicles to repair five faults, including ones in the steering gearbox and headlights.
The cars are the Chrysler Cherokee and Grand Cherokee models imported between September 21, 1992, and February 20, 1997.
No accidents have been reported as a result of the defects.
About 32,000 of the vehicles were sold through Honda's sales network, a Honda spokesman said.
Chrysler Japan said it will pay for all the repairs, which also include replacing a horn.
